text:
• Add a photo of your parked spot, with floor, section and spot number
• Dark mode: system, light or dark theme, the map follows your theme
• Photos are automatically compressed to save storage
• Clear feedback while processing a photo and helpful guidance when photo access is denied
• Restore your data from automatic backups: 25 timestamped restore points
• Minor improvements and bug fixes

• ability to add comment to location
• improvements and bug fixes
